user.title: Configure Smart Room Manager
user.description: Simplified v0.2.0 configuration - Alarm determines presence, no presence/luminosity sensors

list_rooms.title: Manage Rooms
list_rooms.description: No rooms configured. Return to the menu to add a room.

add_room.title: Add Room - Basic Info
add_room.description: Normal type: no timer. Corridor/Bathroom: auto-off timer.

room_sensors.title: Configure Sensors
room_sensors.description: All optional. Windows → frost protection if open.

room_actuators.title: Configure Actuators
room_actuators.description: Bypass: disables all control. External Control: Solar Optimizer, etc. (high priority)

room_climate_config.title: Climate Configuration
room_climate_config.description: Winter/summer temperatures. Window delays: time before reacting to windows. Summer policy: Wire Pilot in summer.

room_climate_advanced.title: Advanced Climate Configuration
room_climate_advanced.description: Dispatch to Wire Pilot or Thermostat advanced configuration.

fil_pilote_hysteresis.title: Wire Pilot - Hysteresis
fil_pilote_hysteresis.description: Temperature sensor acts as a safeguard. Setpoint input is optional.

fil_pilote_presets.title: Wire Pilot - Presets & External Control
fil_pilote_presets.description: Customize Wire Pilot presets and external control settings.

data.preset_comfort: Wire Pilot preset for Comfort mode
data.preset_eco: Wire Pilot preset for Eco mode
data.preset_night: Wire Pilot preset for Night mode
data.preset_away: Wire Pilot preset for Away mode
data.preset_window: Wire Pilot preset for Window open
data.allow_external_in_away: Allow external control in away mode

thermostat_advanced.title: Thermostat - Control Mode
thermostat_advanced.description: Choose how SRM controls the thermostat. Preset only: thermostat manages temperatures.

data.allow_external_in_away: Allow external control in away mode

thermostat_temperatures.title: Thermostat - Temperatures
thermostat_temperatures.description: Target temperatures for thermostat control (temperature/both modes).

room_schedule.title: Schedule Configuration
room_schedule.description: Calendar: external (Google, etc.). Presets: mode when calendar ON/OFF

room_control.title: Room Control Options
room_control.description: Manual pause: default duration of the pause switch. Infinite: no time limit. Manual change: when someone changes the heating by hand, SRM leaves this room alone for this duration, then resumes.

data.manual_override_minutes: Manual change: suspend this room for (min, 0 = off)

delete_room.title: Delete Room
delete_room.description: Are you sure you want to delete {room_name}?

global_settings.title: Global Settings
global_settings.description: Alarm: armed_away → frost protection. Summer calendar: cool mode, winter: heat mode.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what is notified and where. Notify entities: title and message only. Legacy notify actions (e.g. notify.mobile_app_x): with data. Scripts: receive title, message, type, room_id, room_name, entities. Quiet period: notifications go to the fallback targets (none = nothing is sent). Cooldown: minimum delay between two notifications of the same type in the same room. The smart_room_manager_notification event is always fired.

data.notify_quiet_entities: Fallback during quiet period: notify entities
data.notify_quiet_services: Fallback during quiet period: notify actions

missing_entity.title: Missing entity in room {room}
missing_entity.description: The room **{room}** references `{entity}`, which does not exist. Edit the room in the integration options and choose the replacement entity.

unavailable_entity.title: Unavailable entity in room {room}
unavailable_entity.description: `{entity}` used by the room **{room}** has been unavailable for more than 10 minutes. Smart Room Manager cannot use it reliably.

climate_without_actuator.title: Heating without actuator in room {room}
climate_without_actuator.description: The room **{room}** has a heating mode configured but no climate entity. Choose one in the room options, or set the heating mode to none.

multi_controller.title: Actuator driven twice in room {room}
multi_controller.description: `{entity}` is driven by Smart Room Manager and by {other}. Keep a single controller (for Solar Optimizer: let it drive an input_boolean and use it as external control in Smart Room Manager).

setpoint_below_eco.title: Comfort setpoint below eco in room {room}
setpoint_below_eco.description: The comfort setpoint given by `{entity}` ({comfort} °C after clamping) is lower than the eco temperature ({eco} °C). Raise the helper value or remove it from the room.
